name: Candle
notes: Lighting it with a Tinderbox takes a Bonus Action (p. 100).

name: Torch
notes: Lighting it with a Tinderbox takes a Bonus Action (p. 100).

name: Lamp
notes: Burns Oil; a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern (p. 99). Lighting it with a Tinderbox takes a Bonus Action (p. 100).

name: Lantern, Hooded
notes: As a Bonus Action, lower the hood (see hooded-lantern-lowered) or raise it again. A flask of Oil burns for 6 hours (p. 99).

name: Lantern, Hooded (hood lowered)
notes: The hooded lantern with its hood lowered (a Bonus Action to lower or raise).

name: Lantern, Bullseye
notes: Directional: a 60-foot Cone of Bright Light plus 60 feet of Dim Light. Cone angle 53.13° = 2·atan(1/2), from the Cone definition (width at any point equals its distance from the origin, p. 179). A flask of Oil burns for 6 hours (p. 99).
